name: LP333 ID5 CryptoMiniSat parity-recovery discovery
hypothesis: CryptoMiniSat's CNF XOR recovery and bounded Gauss-Jordan matrices may expose parity structure hidden inside the exact ID5 formula and reach a directly verifiable Legendre pair where default and phase-forced CDCL remain unresolved.
evidence_unit: one proofless SAT-discovery run on the audited fixed-family ID5 formula with CryptoMiniSat 5.14.7, one thread, seed zero, frozen XOR and Gauss settings, and a 3600-second cap
claim_boundary: Only a complete assignment satisfying all 1366261 serialized clauses and independently verifying two binary length-333 rows, subgroup {1,211,232} invariance, forced orbit margins, row sums one, and combined PAF minus two at all 332 nonzero shifts decides ID5. XOR telemetry and proofless UNSAT are nondecisive.

baseline.evidence: Exact formula SHA-256 c8c083c7311e083ec5e0bb82d3fca863f2f07e821a30cf55aeb5d79a17778d8b, 218018 variables, 1366261 clauses, and independent unary-channel formula audit status pass.
baseline.measurement: Default one-hour Kissat and the bounded objective-8256 phase pilot returned UNKNOWN. Stronger objective-5280 and objective-4512 phase arms are separate concurrent mechanisms; no directly verified ID5 model exists.

intervention.one_change: Replace Kissat CDCL with pinned single-thread CryptoMiniSat 5.14.7 and its frozen CNF XOR recovery plus bounded Gauss-Jordan matrices while keeping the exact original ID5 formula, family, symmetry, unary channels, seed, cap, and direct verifier fixed.
forbidden_confounds: accepting a partial or unaudited model

controls.name: exact-formula-reconstruction
controls.purpose: Bind the ID5 symmetry formula and unary channels.
controls.expected: The independent audit reconstructs all 1366261 clauses, 4679477 literals, ID5 subgroup orbits, row and shift-111 cardinality channels, exact formula hash, and a rejected literal mutation.

controls.name: tool-and-package-pin
controls.purpose: Bind the parity solver and its dynamically linked implementation.
controls.expected: CryptoMiniSat 5.14.7 executable SHA-256 a3f85c3709b5e2a040bf82a4a604d1c7b9f10219bbf180a9e0f72319a2e892ac, library SHA-256 7952e5a5c77ac8b56253c7a2ad88c62648f20698004338bad9a443efb55b2f84, and Homebrew bottle receipt SHA-256 0309c0559340b1a766058556fad6691da0a97983d7a1195dcd4b7236f1ab33a3.

controls.name: parity-positive-control
controls.purpose: Check SAT status, model extraction, CNF satisfaction, and actual XOR and Gauss activation.
controls.expected: On known SAT ID3 cell 73, the pinned command returns SAT, its complete assignment satisfies every clause, and its trace reports recovered XORs and a used Gauss matrix.

controls.name: frozen-parity-settings
controls.purpose: Ensure the mechanism is one parity-recovery arm.
controls.expected: One thread and seed zero with xor enabled, maximum XOR size 7, bounded XOR discovery and matrices, at most five matrices, and Gauss-useful cutoff 0.2.

controls.name: direct-target-model-audit
controls.purpose: Separate solver telemetry from mathematical evidence.
controls.expected: Any SAT assignment satisfies every CNF clause and independently verifies both full rows, ID5 invariance, forced margins, and every combined PAF equation.

controls.name: runner-pins
controls.purpose: Bind the ID5 adaptation and shared parity mechanism.
controls.expected: ID5 runner SHA-256 c76a9d6cafd6c54427d82a4cf47dade1d4532e6555448ec9d311d8f9eec2fdb4, shared parity runner SHA-256 831cc8c135fce574fc9ea7bba9e47dab31b9b0f6f081dfd826504ee2bd6c2888, shared model runner SHA-256 661e1c17edf1f96cd993c616e99e0a9dc283c955c26b47f039a1bbfadd57ef4a, and direct verifier SHA-256 5ee559052065b1f48066cd2beaf0871e0712c1a350caa359361d5eb5d7f52666.

primary_metric.name: directly verified SAT model for fixed family ID5

terminal_outcomes.promote: CryptoMiniSat returns SAT and the complete assignment passes the exact CNF and independent direct full-length ID5 audit.
terminal_outcomes.park: The run reaches its cap or returns proofless UNSAT without a SAT model while formula, tool, positive-control, and parity controls remain valid.
terminal_outcomes.unknown: A wall, memory, tool, extraction, or verification ceiling interrupts the frozen arm.
terminal_outcomes.audit-failed: Any formula, tool, parity activation, complete-model, CNF, direct-PAF, or family-invariance control fails.

stop_rules: Require the passing independent ID5 unary-channel formula audit.
Require the parity-positive-control trace and complete-model audit before target search.
Run one CryptoMiniSat process with the frozen settings, one thread, and seed zero.
Stop immediately on a directly verified SAT model.
Otherwise terminate at 3600 solver seconds or 4 GiB observed RSS.
Do not rerun with another seed, thread count, configuration, formula, or larger cap.
Do not promote a proofless UNSAT status or parity trace.

next_actions.promote: Freeze the pair, construct H668, independently verify orthogonality and artifact hashes, and package it for the gated submission workflow.
next_actions.park: Archive the non-SAT parity manifest and compare telemetry with the p37q3 parity arm before selecting a distinct exact mechanism.
next_actions.unknown: Preserve the interrupted manifest and resume only the remaining frozen budget if the interruption is reproducible.
next_actions.audit-failed: Repair only the smallest formula, tool, parity, extraction, or direct-verification defect before rerunning.

authority.data_scope: Local public-prompt artifacts, source-pinned repositories, official open-source solver code, and public primary literature are authorized for the autonomous campaign.
authority.external_actions: A fully audited H668 candidate may be prepared; actual external submission remains gated by exact destination, artifact, account, and contract terms.
